channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26 and 27.

item.title: MyStat 0.2.3
item.description:
MyStat 0.2.3 updates the bundled Sparkle framework from 2.10.0 to 2.10.1, which fixes an update being installed too early from certain Unicode paths and release-notes links with stray whitespace. It is not a security release, and MyStat's own features and code are unchanged.
macOS 27 is the primary target; macOS 26 remains supported until macOS 28 is released. macOS 27 power-sensor mappings remain experimental. Automatic update checks remain off by default; no telemetry or new runtime dependencies.
Tested with the automated and Sparkle integration suites, and a signed 0.2.2 to 0.2.3 Sparkle upgrade on macOS 26.6 and 27.0.1. Prepared with substantial AI assistance (Claude Code).
